Information Science Branch Paper 001, version 1.4.0 - complete-field SFT V3 reconstruction.

This paper reports 262 of 262 frozen Information Science obligations admitted through the unchanged Smithian Fold Theory engine: 75,776 exact candidates and decisions, 262 unique survivors, 1,048 passing adverse controls and 262 implementation-distinct reconstructions. The 250 complete-field successor laws additionally carry post-registry observation packages, while the twelve foundational laws retain their original reconstructed receipts and are bound by the complete validation vector.

The branch reconstructs symbols, distinguishability and representation; records and provenance; source, process, sequence, spatial and network information; exact measures; signal, sampling and quantization; compression and distortion; channels and capacity; noise and error; coding; conditional, mutual, directed and shared-information relations; coarse-graining; retrieval; inference; privacy; information thermodynamics; classical-probabilistic-quantum support correspondence; semantic/reference boundaries; complete validation; and one-owner cross-branch handoffs.

The headline unification is exact distinction custody. Information is complete generated alternative support plus exact records of distinctions retained and closed by observation. Entropy retains every observation class and unresolved pair. Probability is an exact part of deterministic support, not a stochastic cause. Compression, capacity and error correction are exact support-separation laws. Semantic records preserve reference and context without pretending to replace biological function, cognition, consciousness, qualia or red-of-red.

The paper integrates the technical record with the Ernos Labs open-source science mission: public derivations, complete adverse evidence, revocable standards conformance, retained authorship, free criticism and identical evidential gates for independent and institutional researchers.
